run_SpeechUnitsModule: run the SpeechUnitsModule to compute Wav2vec speech units for an audio manifest file using hydra config
build_SpeechUnitsConfig: build a SpeechUnitsConfig dataclass with shards, output_dir, column, and tokenizer settings for speech unit extraction
use_units_to_text: use units_to_text to convert a 2D or 3D speech unit tensor into a human-readable space-separated string
review_SpeechUnitsModule_tokenizer: review the SpeechUnitsModule tokenizer cached property that resolves a speech tokenizer from string or dict config
test_SpeechUnitsModule_run: test the SpeechUnitsModule run method to encode audio segments from a TSV shard and write units to output
